title: About iOS 27 Updates - Apple Support
text:
# About iOS 27 Updates

iOS 27 introduces the next generation of Apple Intelligence and Siri AI, as well as new features to help parents create safe digital experiences for kids, and improvements that make iOS more responsive and delightful to use. Siri AI is an entirely new version of Siri that is more intelligent, knowledgeable, and capable. The next generation of Apple Intelligence also powers new features across apps that simplify the things you do every day, like editing images in Photos, communicating in Messages and Mail, and browsing in Safari. New parental controls and significant updates to Screen Time make it more intuitive and easy to use, so parents can feel confident that they're building the right digital experience for their child. And with improvements that span design, performance, connectivity, search, and more, the experience on iOS 27 has been refined and elevated, so it feels even better to use.

## Which iOS versions are supported by Apple?

iOS 27 is Apple’s current iPhone operating system and the version receiving new features and functionality. It can run on the iPhone 11 and newer, as well as the iPhone SE (2nd generation) and later.

Every iPhone that supports iOS 26 also supports iOS 27. Apple is continuing to issue security updates for iOS 26, releasing iOS 26.7.3 alongside iOS 27.2.1 on November 9, 2026. It also released iOS 18.7.12 for the iPhone XS, iPhone XS Max and iPhone XR, which cannot upgrade to iOS 26 or iOS 27.

Apple also periodically releases security updates for considerably older versions of iOS on devices that can no longer upgrade to a newer release.

title: Apple releases iOS 27.2.1 for iPhone, here's what's new - 9to5Mac
text:
# Apple releases iOS 27.2.1 for iPhone, here’s what’s new

 Ryan Christoffel | Nov 9 2026 - 10:09 am PT 

Apple has released a minor new software update for iPhone users today: iOS 27.2.1. Here’s what’s new.

## iOS 27.2.1 introduces new bug fixes and security updates for iPhone

iOS 27.2 launched late in October as a major update packed with new features.

Today, Apple has another new iPhone software update rolling out: iOS 27.2.1.

As often happens when a big update arrives, Apple has followed up with a minor release that addresses some bugs in the last update and adds the latest security fixes too.

Here are Apple’s official release notes:

> This update provides bug fixes and security updates for your iPhone.
> 
> For information on the security content of Apple software updates, please visit: https://support.apple.com/100100

Apple’s webpage linked above hasn’t yet received details on the new security updates, but it should be updated in the coming hours with those specifics.

If you own an iPad, iPadOS 27.2.1 has also been released with similar fixes.

The next big update that will offer new features is iOS 27.3, which is currently available in beta. It includes major Siri AI upgrades including Siri Recap, plus new Apple Music features, and a lot more.

title: Apple rolls out iOS 27.2.1, iPadOS 27.2.1, iOS 26.7.3, and more — Appleosophy
text:
Apple has started rolling out iOS 27.2.1 and iPadOS 27.2.1 to the public. These updates come two weeks after the release of iOS 27.2 and iPadOS 27.2 to the public, which included enhancements to Siri AI, Edge Light and Apple Pencil support for the iPhone Duo, a new Apple Music icon, fixes to several security vulnerabilities, and more.

...

Apple has also started rolling out iOS 26.7.3, iPadOS 26.7.3, iOS 18.7.12, and iPadOS 18.7.12, likely addressing the same security vulnerabilities. The oldest iPhones receiving an update today are the iPhone Xs, iPhone Xs Max, and iPhone XR, which are almost 8 years old. Although the update won’t bring any of the new features to these older devices, it will still keep the device secure with these updates.
